connector.name: Varosity
connector.registryDescription: One key for AI video, voice, music, and image across 40+ frontier models. BYOK zero markup.
connector.summary: Hosted at varosity.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jonkludt account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
